title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Disputed Amount on a Demurrage Line
content:
## Definition

For a Demurrage and Detention Free Time demurrage line disputed because rates or free time were misapplied, the disputed amount is the amount still open on the line less the dangerous-goods uplift share of that open amount (a share of nothing when no uplift applies). The subtraction is made on unrounded figures, and only the finished disputed amount is taken to the nearest cent.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical)

| Amount still open | Uplift share | Disputed amount |
|---|---|---|
| 900.00 (share taken at an assumed 20 percent) | 150.00 | 750.00 |
| 1000.00 (share taken at an assumed 30 percent) | 230.769… | 769.23 |
| 640.00 (no uplift) | nothing | 640.00 |

In the second row the share is carried with all its decimals, and only the disputed amount of 769.2307… is rounded, giving 769.23.
